text: みがわり　おもしろそう　なのにー

structure.jp: おもしろそう　なのにー

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう put on a describing word with its last い dropped says how something looks or seems to you. おもしろそう = 'seems fun'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', and left hanging at the end it sounds disappointed. The long ー is a whine. おもしろそう なのにー = 'but it seems so fun...'.
